objectName: CineGlide Pro 3-Axis Motorized Camera Slider & Pan/Tilt Head
safetyNotes: Never unplug a NEMA17 stepper motor while the TMC2209 drivers are energized with 12V/15V USB-C PD power.
Balance your camera lens fore/aft in the Arca-Swiss clamp before enabling the Axis-3 tilt motor.

steps.title: Slide Dual 2020 V-Slot Rails into Left Motor End Block
steps.note: Insert the left ends of both 2020 V-Slot Aluminum Extrusions (OTS-01) into the 60mm-spaced sockets of PRT-01 (Left Drive Block) and lock with 4× M5×10mm screws and T-nuts.
steps.description: Insert the left ends of both 2020 V-Slot Aluminum Extrusions (OTS-01) into the 60mm-spaced sockets of PRT-01 (Left Drive Block) and lock with 4× M5×10mm screws and T-nuts.

steps.title: Attach Fold-Out All-Terrain Outrigger Legs (×4)
steps.note: Bolt the 4× PRT-03 Articulated Outrigger Legs to the corner bosses of PRT-01 and PRT-02 using M5×20mm pivot bolts and nyloc nuts.
steps.description: Bolt the 4× PRT-03 Articulated Outrigger Legs to the corner bosses of PRT-01 and PRT-02 using M5×20mm pivot bolts and nyloc nuts.

steps.title: Assemble 4-Wheel Delrin V-Slot Gantry Carriage & Roll onto Rails
steps.note: Mount the 4× Delrin POM V-Wheels (OTS-05) onto PRT-04 (Gantry Carriage Plate) with the two 6mm eccentric spacers on the rear row, slide onto the 2020 rails, and turn the eccentric nuts until play disappears.
steps.description: Mount the 4× Delrin POM V-Wheels (OTS-05) onto PRT-04 (Gantry Carriage Plate) with the two 6mm eccentric spacers on the rear row, slide onto the 2020 rails, and turn the eccentric nuts until play disappears.

steps.title: Cap Right Rail End with Idler Block & Tension GT2 Belt
steps.note: Slide PRT-02 (Right Idler Block) onto the right ends of the 2020 rails, loop the GT2-6mm timing belt (OTS-04) around the 20T drive pulley and right idler, and tighten the M5 tensioner screw.
steps.description: Slide PRT-02 (Right Idler Block) onto the right ends of the 2020 rails, loop the GT2-6mm timing belt (OTS-04) around the 20T drive pulley and right idler, and tighten the M5 tensioner screw.

steps.title: Bolt Axis-2 Pan Turntable Housing & Seat 6808 Bearing
steps.note: Fasten PRT-05 (Pan Turntable Housing) to the center of the gantry carriage plate and press the 6808-2RS thin-section bearing flush into its upper race.
steps.description: Fasten PRT-05 (Pan Turntable Housing) to the center of the gantry carriage plate and press the 6808-2RS thin-section bearing flush into its upper race.

steps.title: Install 3× NEMA17 Stepper Motors (Slide, Pan & Tilt)
steps.note: Mount the three NEMA17 Bipolar Stepper Motors (OTS-02) into PRT-01 (Slide), PRT-05 (Pan), and PRT-07 (Tilt) using M3×8mm socket head screws and fit the 20T GT2 pinions.
steps.description: Mount the three NEMA17 Bipolar Stepper Motors (OTS-02) into PRT-01 (Slide), PRT-05 (Pan), and PRT-07 (Tilt) using M3×8mm socket head screws and fit the 20T GT2 pinions.

steps.title: Engage 60-Tooth Pan Reduction Ring Gear (3:1)
steps.note: Seat PRT-06 (60T Pan Ring Gear) onto the 6808-2RS bearing hub and mesh its teeth with the 20T pan stepper pinion.
steps.description: Seat PRT-06 (60T Pan Ring Gear) onto the 6808-2RS bearing hub and mesh its teeth with the 20T pan stepper pinion.

steps.title: Mount Axis-3 Cantilever Tilt Gimbal U-Yoke
steps.note: Bolt PRT-07 (Tilt Gimbal U-Yoke) onto the top face of the 60T pan ring gear with 4× M3×12mm screws.
steps.description: Bolt PRT-07 (Tilt Gimbal U-Yoke) onto the top face of the 60T pan ring gear with 4× M3×12mm screws.

steps.title: Pivot Camera Tilt Cradle & Lock Arca-Swiss Quick-Release Clamp
steps.note: Insert PRT-08 (Camera Tilt Cradle) into the U-yoke trunnion, loop the closed-loop 200mm GT2 belt over the tilt motor pulley, and bolt the Aluminum Arca-Swiss Clamp (OTS-08) on top.
steps.description: Insert PRT-08 (Camera Tilt Cradle) into the U-yoke trunnion, loop the closed-loop 200mm GT2 belt over the tilt motor pulley, and bolt the Aluminum Arca-Swiss Clamp (OTS-08) on top.

steps.title: Clip Electronics Case & Seat 3× Silent TMC2209 Drivers + ESP32 OLED
steps.note: Snap PRT-09 (Controller Side Case) onto the left rail block, install the 3× TMC2209 drivers (OTS-03), ESP32 OLED board (OTS-06), and USB-C PD 12V/15V trigger board (OTS-07), and plug in the 3 stepper cables.
steps.description: Snap PRT-09 (Controller Side Case) onto the left rail block, install the 3× TMC2209 drivers (OTS-03), ESP32 OLED board (OTS-06), and USB-C PD 12V/15V trigger board (OTS-07), and plug in the 3 stepper cables.
